name: Algebra 1 Practice Sets Course Profile
role: Course-specific layer for rendering finalized Algebra Bank Practice destinations into deployed student Practice resources. It does not author new questions.

canonical_source.rule: The finalized Unit Bank is canonical for Practice Set 1, Practice Set 2, Practice Set 3, Extra Practice, CYU, Tarsia, and Blooket content. Render/copy these destinations faithfully; do not rewrite or diversify questions.
canonical_source.mismatch_rule: If the current Framework Assessment Plan/Practice inventory materially conflicts with the Bank, report an upstream blocking mismatch rather than silently repairing the Bank downstream.

practice_set_2.dashboard_location: teacher resources for assignment-choice only; not an answer key

practice_set_3.dashboard_location: teacher resources for assignment-choice only; not an answer key

abundance_and_repetition.rule: Purposeful Algebra repetition is desirable. The renderer preserves the Bank's repeated procedural families, numeric variants, and exact duplicates without anti-clone rewriting.
abundance_and_repetition.family_pattern: A 24-question form may intentionally contain several clusters of 3-5 closely related high-value questions. Do not maximize shell variety.
abundance_and_repetition.form_role_rule: Do not reinterpret Practice 1/2/3/Extra as a universal difficulty or reasoning ladder. They are parallel usable options unless the current Bank/Assessment Plan explicitly says otherwise.

response_mode.blooket: selected response allowed only in the canonical Blooket export

representation_rule: Render every canonical graph/table/context/diagram the student must use. Do not replace representations with prose. Preserve graph/table content and graph-friendly values from the Bank.

student_page.visible_metadata: question number only; hidden data-bank-id traceability is allowed; no visible DOK/Bloom/I-can/Bank ID/question-family/source labels
student_page.answers: Do not render Bank answers/solutions or Alignment/evidence panels on Practice pages.
student_page.numbering: Sequential local numbering in destination order; hidden data-bank-id is allowed for traceability.
student_page.multipart: Keep one coherent canonical multipart item under one visible number.

page_titles.rule: Use the same exact short name in both the HTML <title> and visible <h1>. Do not prepend the long course/unit/section title.

student_page.title_visual: navy text with horizontal navy rule underneath; no filled title box

css_reference: reference_library/deployment/shared_css/practice_set.css (byte-identical mirror of Base Practice Starter universal practice_set.css)

workspace.rule: Initial generated ordinary Practice pages use ws-25 for every problem. Teacher can manually increase an individual problem with existing ws-N utility classes. Do not auto-inflate workspace during the normal build. CYU is the explicit exception defined below.

figures.generator_rule: Copy finalized Bank figure bytes exactly. Do not run/copy the Framework graph tool and do not create or package Practice graph-generator scripts. Missing canonical visuals are upstream Bank defects.
figures.caption_rule: Do not emit visible decorative graph figcaptions/titles. Preserve mathematically necessary labels that are part of the canonical visual.

tables.two_column_rule: Ordinary two-column data tables use classes "values compact-table" with a two-column colgroup whose cols use "half-col"; preserve all canonical headings/cells exactly.
tables.two_column_visual: compact, centered, minimum useful width about 2.35in, 50/50 columns; do not stretch to full page width
tables.other_tables: Preserve canonical structure and use normal universal Practice/base table behavior unless another approved class is required.

exports.tarsia_rule: Copy the canonical Bank export; `_practice_3` is only a deployment filename convention and does not imply derivation from Practice Set 3.
exports.blooket_rule: Copy the canonical Bank export; do not synthesize choices from Practice Set 3.

package.root_rule: Section folders directly at ZIP root; extract into course-root practice_sets/.

qa: 24/24/24/24/6 Algebra HTML counts per section unless the current Framework explicitly changes them
18 Tarsia pairs and 20 Blooket questions when those exports are used
all required HTML classes attached so practice_set.css rules fire
base.css then practice_set.css from final deployed-relative paths
no answers or visible internal metadata in student HTML; hidden data-bank-id traceability is allowed
exact short Algebra page-title pattern used in both <title> and <h1>; h1 is navy text with horizontal rule and no fill
ordinary two-column data tables use compact-table + half-col structure
CYU renders 6 questions as a 3x2 grid with no per-question workspace and one blank full-page workspace afterward
no graph tool or Practice graph-generator script packaged
Framework practice_set.css mirror is byte-identical to the Base Practice universal stylesheet

cyu_layout.rule: Keep all six canonical CYU questions separate and in order; change layout only.
